notes: Compare two versions of a Word document: download a blackline with edits the other side made without tracking listed first, and ask in chat what each change does and who it favours. Record the client you act for on a matter, and optionally the matter's own Posture, so drafting knows whose side you're on. The other side's tracked changes are read as proposals, not agreed text. Drafts carry page numbers, a dated draft line and, if you set one, your firm's legend. Also: add emails and Excel files to a matter, chat answers that appear live and show while they're working, and uploading a file with an existing name no longer replaces it.
